_doc: The event catalogue of the VRUN SFX Configurator. 'events' are the 44 events of the page of 2026-08-24 (id, category, name, desc copied from it, 'was' = its main.fab location then) plus a few events named by BrokenDev for call sites that appeared later ('since': the work that added them). 'match' ties an event to today's trigger call sites in src/game/main.fab: fn = the enclosing function (exact); clip = the clip the site plays (optional); prev = a regex that must match one of the 8 code lines before the call; last = a regex that must match the code line right before it; section = a regex that must match the nearest 'section marker' line above the call in the same function (sectionMarkers below: the menu row tests, app states, pause flips); 'match' may also be a list of such rules (any one matching is enough). The first event whose rule matches a site owns it; an event can own several sites (one row per site). A call site no rule owns is still listed, named from 'functions' (or from its function name). An event of 2026-08 that owns no site today is listed as 'not in today's game' unless an event that owns sites names it in 'replaces'.
